summary: The deal to end it now: {the crisis} is on you now, and {seller} offers to end it with a long deal at a high price.
realLife: One life: In California's 2001 electricity crisis he declared an emergency and the state agreed to pay $43 billion for power over 20 years, deals critics called overpriced. He kept household rates capped. In 1999 he had signed a pension expansion after the retirement board said it would need no added state money. Another: He backed a deal giving Foxconn billions in subsidies to build a plant in Wisconsin, and lost re-election in 2018.
gates: {the crisis} is on record in your place.
{seller} has offered a deal on record.
weights: How close your next race is.
choices: open the books on the deal first

branches.then: Prices fall back within a year, and you are stuck paying the old price. Reporters sue to see the terms.
